title: Pollinations models now plug directly into LLM
summary:
A busy garden: native LLM integration, new agent quests, richer community discovery, and sturdier image and streaming paths.

The new llm-pollinations package brings authenticated Pollinations chat models into LLM 0.35 as native pollinations/<model-id> entries, with streaming, multi-turn chat, image attachments, tool calls, and async support. Agent builders also get intact metadata across text endpoints and richer headers, multipart files, and payloads in background generation. Less glue code; more strange little agents.

The app directory added Manhwa Studio for building generated webtoons and Co-Eco-Graph for exploring EVM indexing ecosystems as illustrated interactive graphs. Fourteen existing catalog entries also gained screenshots, so browsing no longer requires quite as much faith.

Markdown in shared UI components now renders inline images, audio, and video—including generated-media URLs that do not politely end in file extensions—alongside wrapping, labelled code blocks with copy controls. Community model publishers also now have clean icons throughout endpoint and catalog views.

highlights.title: Make a webtoon
highlights.text: Manhwa Studio brings character profiles, scene planning, generated panels, dialogue bubbles, and a vertical comic canvas into one workspace. [Try it](https://manhwa-studio-320488177521.asia-southeast1.run.app).

highlights.title: Explore contracts as graphs
highlights.text: Paste an EVM contract address into Co-Eco-Graph to explore its subgraphs, entities, and event handlers as an interactive graph with AI fantasy illustration. [Try it](https://ceg-wine.vercel.app).

highlights.title: Pollinations in LLM
highlights.text: Install `llm-pollinations` to use chat-capable Pollinations models in LLM 0.35 as `pollinations/<model-id>`, with catalog-driven vision, tool, and reasoning support.

highlights.title: Media right in Markdown
highlights.text: The shared UI now displays images, audio, and video inline—even when generated-media URLs have no file extension. Code blocks are labelled, wrap long lines, and can be copied.

highlights.title: Agent quests earn Pollen
highlights.text: Use a qualifying agent for a one-time 0.25 Pollen quest, or create an agent that gets used to qualify for a 2 Pollen quest.
